verdict.rationale: Graphite exposes programmatic surfaces for its core stacking workflow: the gt CLI handles stack creation and amending, and the official GT MCP server lets agents create stacked PRs. However, no public REST/OpenAPI API was found (all OpenAPI probes returned 404). UI features such as AI review customization, Insights, the merge queue, Graphite Chat and Agents are documented only as UI/click-driven. Missing for 10: a documented public API, programmatic access to AI reviews/custom rules, Insights, merge queue, Chat/Agents and inbox filters, and any evidence of UI–API parity.
